characters.name: Ram
characters.role: prince of Ayodhya, eldest son of Dasharath, Lord Vishnu's avatar
characters.look: Lord Ram: a calm, youthful prince with smooth dark blue (neel-shyam) skin, a tall gold crown, a yellow silk dhoti and a gold-bordered angavastram draped over his shoulders, gold necklaces, a long bow (Kodanda) in hand and a quiver of arrows on his back

characters.name: Sita
characters.role: princess of Mithila, daughter of Janak, Ram's wife
characters.look: Mother Sita: a youthful, radiant goddess with a divine glow and serene face, a small jewelled gold crown and maang tikka, a red silk saree with gold border, rich gold jewellery, head modestly covered with the end of the saree

characters.name: Lakshman
characters.role: Ram's devoted younger brother, son of Sumitra
characters.look: Lakshman: a fair-skinned young prince with a gold crown, a yellow dhoti and angavastram over his shoulders, gold necklaces and a bow, always beside Ram

characters.name: Vishwamitra
characters.role: the great sage who takes Ram and Lakshman to guard his yagya
characters.look: Sage Vishwamitra: a tall, stern sage with a long grey beard and matted hair, a fiery gaze, saffron robes and a wooden staff

characters.name: Janak
characters.look: King Janak: a wise, gentle king with a grey beard, a gold crown and white and gold silk robes

characters.name: Parshuram
characters.role: the fierce warrior-sage, an avatar of Vishnu
characters.look: Parshuram: a fierce, muscular warrior-sage with matted hair and a beard, a saffron dhoti, an axe (parshu) on his shoulder and a great bow

setting: Ancient India in the Treta Yuga: the golden city of Ayodhya on the Saryu river, the dense forests of the south, the vanara kingdom of Kishkindha and the golden island city of Lanka.

episodes.title: Divine Call: Rama's Forest Journey
episodes.description: When a celestial summons disrupts Ayodhya’s peace, Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana embark on a perilous adventure that will test their devotion.
episodes.summary: The kingdom of Ayodhya basks in peace, but a divine whisper shatters the calm. Rama, the beloved prince, receives a mysterious summons from the sage Vishwamitra. Sita and Lakshmana watch anxiously as destiny begins to stir. Vishwamitra arrives, urging Rama to protect the sacred yajna from the menacing demons that haunt the forest. Reluctant yet duty-bound, Rama accepts, but Lakshmana’s protective instincts flare, fearing for his brother’s safety. Sita, though bound to the palace, offers a blessing that strengthens Rama’s resolve. The trio prepares to leave, unaware that a dark presence watches from the shadows. At dawn, Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana step onto the forest path, the air thick with anticipation. Suddenly, a thunderous roar erupts as a massive demon, Tataka, emerges, blocking their way. Rama draws his bow, eyes blazing, while Sita clutches a talisman for protection. The episode ends as the demon lunges, leaving their fate hanging in the balance for the next episode.

episodes.title: Tataka's Fall
episodes.description: Rama confronts the ferocious demon Tataka, testing his divine resolve and the trio’s unity.
episodes.summary: The forest trembles as Tataka roars, sending shivers through the ancient trees. राम, bow drawn, steps forward with fierce determination, while सीता clutches her talisman, whispering a protective mantra. लक्ष्मण stays close, his hand on राम’s shoulder, ready to intervene at the first sign of danger. The demon lunges, its massive claws tearing at the foliage and threatening to crush the siblings. लक्ष्मण leaps to block the strike, his blade flashing, but Tataka’s dark aura sears his arm, forcing him to retreat. In desperation, सीता chants an ancient hymn, the talisman glowing bright and momentarily weakening Tataka’s power, giving राम a chance to aim. Rama steadies his breath, feeling the divine wind guide his arrow. With a thunderous release, राम lets loose a celestial arrow that pierces Tataka’s heart, and the demon lets out a final, earth‑shaking scream. The forest falls silent as Tataka collapses, but her dying roar reveals a hidden cavern opening beneath the roots, glowing with an eerie crimson light. As राम, सीता, and लक्ष्मण approach the cavern, a cold wind carries a whisper of a far greater menace, leaving them poised on the brink of a new peril.

episodes.title: विश्वामित्र और ताड़का वध
episodes.description: विवेक और कर्तव्य की परीक्षा—विश्वामित्र की यज्ञ रक्षा में राम‑लक्ष्मण का पवित्र यात्रा।
episodes.summary: Vishwamitra arrives at King Dasharath's court, pleading that the young prince Ram protect his upcoming yajna from the marauding rakshasas. Dasharath, torn by fatherly love, first offers his seasoned army, feeling his heart break at the thought of sending his son away. Sage Vasishtha intervenes, reminding the king of Ram’s divine purpose, and convinces him to send only Ram and Lakshman with the sage. At the serene banks of the Saryu, Vishwamitra sits with Ram and Lakshman and imparts the powerful Bala and Atibala mantras, chanting them in rhythmic cadence. The brothers repeat the verses, feeling an inner fire kindle and their resolve sharpen under the sage’s guidance. The river’s gentle flow mirrors the rising strength within them, preparing them for the trials ahead. Entering the foreboding forest, Vishwamitra recounts the terror of the demoness Tataka, who haunts the sages and disrupts the sacred rites. Ram hesitates, troubled by the idea of killing a woman, but the sage sternly explains that dharma demands protection of the sages above all. With a calm breath, Ram draws his bow, releases a single divine arrow, and Tataka falls; Vishwamitra, pleased, signals that he will soon bestow upon Ram the celestial weapons destined for his future deeds.

episodes.title: दिव्यास्त्र और यज्ञ की रक्षा
episodes.description: राम और लक्ष्मण के अद्भुत शस्त्रों की प्राप्ति और यज्ञ की रक्षा की महाकाव्य कथा। देखिए कैसे दो भाई राक्षसों के आक्रमण को पराजित कर यज्ञ को सफल बनाते हैं।
episodes.summary: Vishwamitra bestows the divine Manav and Agneyastras upon Ram, explaining their power and purpose. Ram receives the celestial weapons with humility and reverence. The sage then leads the brothers to Siddhashram where the sages commence a six‑day yajna, and Ram and Lakshman vow to guard it day and night. The first five days pass with serene vigilance as the brothers meditate, tend the sacred fire, and fend off minor disturbances. On the sixth day, the demon Mareech, now appearing as a golden deer, joins his brother Subahu and a horde of rakshasas to assault the yajna. Dark clouds gather over the ashram as tension mounts. At the climax, Ram invokes his Manav Astra, hurling Mareech a hundred yojanas into the ocean, then unleashes his Agneyastra to incinerate Subahu. Lakshman, with his bow, slays the remaining demons, securing the yajna’s completion. Vishwamitra, delighted, announces the forthcoming bow‑ceremony of King Janak in Mithila, setting the stage for the next journey.

episodes.title: अहल्या उद्धार
episodes.description: राम और लक्ष्मण की यात्रा में गंगा के अवतरण की कथा और अहल्या की मुक्ति का अद्भुत दृश्य, अंत में मिथिला की नगरी की पहली झलक।
episodes.summary: On their journey toward Mithila, Sage Vishwamitra pauses to recount the legend of Bhagiratha’s arduous penance that coaxed the Ganga down from the heavens, describing how the river’s descent purified the world. The brothers listen intently, feeling the weight of destiny and the power of devotion that shaped the cosmos. This story deepens their reverence for dharma and prepares them for the trials ahead. Arriving at the deserted hermitage of Gautam, Vishwamitra explains how Indra, disguised as a sage, deceived Ahalya and how Gautam, enraged, cursed her to become a stone. As Ram gently places his divine feet upon the stone, a radiant glow surrounds it, and Ahalya is liberated, rising in serene white garments. She bows deeply to Ram, thanking him, and is reunited with her husband Gautam, who greets the brothers with gratitude and blessing. With Ahalya’s liberation complete, Ram, Lakshman, and Vishwamitra resume their march. The horizon soon reveals the shining towers and bustling streets of Janakpur, its golden domes glittering under the sun. The princes stand in awe, their hearts swelling with anticipation for the forthcoming bow‑ceremony, concluding the episode.

episodes.title: पुष्प वाटिका: राम-सीता का प्रथम दर्शन
episodes.description: जनकपुर में राजसी स्वागत, प्रथम दृष्टि और भाग्य की पहली आशा। फूलवाटिका में प्रेम की प्रार्थना, और पिनाक धनुष को उठाने की चिंता के साथ नई सुबह की शुरुआत।
episodes.summary: The episode opens as Sage Vishwamitra, accompanied by Rama and Lakshman, arrives at the splendid city of Mithila. King Janak greets them with reverent bows, offering fragrant garlands and a grand feast, while expressing deep admiration for the two princes. He invites the sage to stay and promises to honor him during the upcoming ceremony. Rama and Lakshman wander through the bustling streets, marveling at the golden towers and the scent of jasmine in the air. They enter the royal flower garden to collect blossoms for their guru, where they catch sight of Sita for the first time, radiant in a red sari. Sita, moved by the sight, folds her hands and prays to Mother Gauri, asking the goddess to bless Rama as her husband, and a gentle divine breeze signals the goddess’s benediction. King Janak, observing the awe‑struck princes, worries aloud that no mortal king has yet been able to lift the mighty bow Pinaka, fearing his kingdom may lack a true hero. He confides his concern to Vishwamitra, who reassures him that destiny will reveal the worthy. As night gives way to dawn, the palace prepares for the bow‑lifting ceremony, and the episode ends on the quiet morning before the ritual begins, filled with hopeful anticipation.

episodes.title: शिव धनुष भंग
episodes.description: राजाओं की भीड़, शिव धनुष की परीक्षा और राम का अद्भुत पराक्रम—देखिए कैसे धनुष टूटता है और सीता की माला राम पर बंधती है।
episodes.summary: The grand bow‑lifting ceremony begins as kings from every corner of the earth arrive at Janak’s palace, each eager to demonstrate their might. One by one they grasp the mighty Pinaka, but none can even budge it, and the king’s heart sinks in despair. Lakshman, inflamed by the mounting failure, fumes loudly, but Ram gently restrains his brother with calm words, reminding him of dharma. At Vishwamitra’s gentle command, Ram bows reverently to his guru before the assembled crowd. With a steady breath he lifts the colossal bow, his divine strength evident, and as he draws the string the tension builds to a deafening roar. The bow snaps cleanly, shattering into pieces with a thunderous crash that reverberates through the hall, echoing like the roar of a celestial storm. In the stunned silence that follows, Sita steps forward, her eyes shining with devotion, and places a fragrant garland around Ram’s neck, proclaiming him her husband. The reverberation of the broken bow carries far, its echo summoning the fierce sage Parshuram, whose fury is now awakened. The episode ends as the thunder of the shattered bow heralds Parshuram’s impending arrival.
